sources.title: gracemaker
sources.snippet: GRACE-3L: Semi-local, non-linear model with a third message-passing layer for a larger effective receptive field, offering the best accuracy of the series. Available as foundation models (natively fp32) for use in python or in LAMMPS, including the TensorFlow-free grace/3l/kk Kokkos pair style.
